kjv: that hath a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard
mine: who is a medium or a spiritist
note: Hebrew ki yihyeh vahem ov o yidde'oni, "in whom there is a ghost (ov) or a knowing spirit (yidde'oni)", i.e. one who practises necromancy; "familiar spirit" and "wizard" suggest European witchcraft rather than consulting the dead.
